paragraphs.text: DSH plugin: restores title-bar dragging and double-click zoom in DeepSeek Harness Desktop (macOS)
# dsh-window-drag

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that restores normal title-bar behavior in **DSH
Desktop on macOS**: press

and drag an empty title-bar area to move the window,
and double-click it to zoom (fill the screen w

ork area; double-click again to
restore the previous bounds).
## Why

Some DSH Desktop builds ignore `-webkit-app-region: drag`, so the shell's own
`[data-window-drag]` r

egions never make the window draggable — the window can
only be moved by the traffic lights or not a

t all. This plugin bypasses CSS
drag regions entirely and moves the native window with `window.moveB

y()` /
`window.moveTo()` / `window.resizeTo()`, which Electron honors for the main
window.
## Behavior

- **Drag zones:** the top 48px title strip (the shell's
`--dsh-frame-top-clearance`) across the full

width, plus the sidebar header
block (300×104px).
- **DoubleClick:** toggles macOS-style zoom using

the screen work area.
- **While zoomed:** starting a drag shrinks the window to its previous
size c

entered on the cursor (clamped to the screen boundaries) and continues
the drag; double-click restor

es the previous bounds.
(Renderer-driven window moves are clamped to the screen by Chromium, so a
fu

ll-work-area window cannot slide as-is. The shell's native resize-border
drag — grabbing the extreme

window edge — is handled by the macOS window
server instead and is *not* clamped: it can move the w

indow off-screen or to
another monitor while resizing. This plugin never intercepts those edge
drags

; its zones are the top strip and sidebar header only.)
- **Boot rescue:** if a previous session end

ed with the window fully outside
the screen (possible via the native edge drag), the plugin brings i

t back to
the screen work area at launch.
- **Never captured:** buttons, links, tabs, inputs, `conte

nteditable`, menus,
dialogs, and any element tagged `data-no-window-drag` — clicks keep working.
- *

*Disabled in fullscreen** and entirely inert on Windows/Linux or in an
ordinary browser tab (gated o

n the `data-platform="darwin"` attribute that
only the Electron preload writes).
## Install

From DSH Desktop, open **Settings → Plugins** (Plugin Manager) and install the
bundle from:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
or clone and install the local directory:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then install the `dsh-window-drag/` directory through the Plugin Manager
("Install bundle…"). The pl
ugin activates immediately; no restart is needed.
To uninstall, remove the bundle from the Plugin Manager.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness Desktop (developed against 0.2.1-rc.5)
- macOS; other platforms are unaffected
## Development

This is a Cordis bundle: `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `window-drag` row,
`index.js` is an empty Ho

st half, and `client.js` registers the Client module
that attaches the pointer listeners. All listen

ers are removed when the plugin
is disabled or uninstalled.
